description: This file contains implementation code for IPFS URL rewriting and gateway handling within the cURL project, including functions to determine IPFS gateway URLs and convert ipfs:// or ipns:// URLs to HTTP(S) URLs suitable for gateways.

methods.name: CURLcode ensure_trailing_slash(char ** input)
methods.description: Ensures that the given input string ends with a slash ('/'). If not, appends a slash to it, using dynamic buffer management.

methods.name: char * ipfs_gateway(void)
methods.description: Determines the IPFS gateway URL by first checking environment variables, then reading from configuration files or default locations, and ensuring it ends with a slash.

methods.name: CURLcode ipfs_url_rewrite(CURLU * uh,const char * protocol,char ** url,struct OperationConfig * config)
methods.description: Rewrites ipfs:// or ipns:// URLs into HTTP(S) URLs using a configured or detected IPFS gateway, modifying the URL components accordingly.

ctags.name: ipfs_url_rewrite
ctags.signature: (CURLU * uh,const char * protocol,char ** url,struct OperationConfig * config)
